scope: native v5 shutdown dispatch and callback admission
preserved_failures: initial v5 callback dispatch lacked callback admission
failed reboot could strand a newly closed admission gate
application Open and topology callbacks temporarily lost legacy operation serialization
fallible ApplicationConnection allocation could drop BackendApplication and call provider Close while holding the operation mutex

review.remaining_required_test: force ApplicationConnection allocation failure and prove a provider Close callback can reenter a serialized topology query without deadlock

implemented_after_review: explicitly release the operation mutex after successful provider Open and before fallible connection allocation
exercise a successful resident ApplicationConnection: shutdown is EBUSY until close, close precedes successful shutdown
excluded: independent PASS review of the final source
